    "192.168.5.0",
]

    result = framework_evidence.run_tool(command)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))

    print(json.dumps({
        "command": command,
        "status": "error",
        "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
        "error": str(exc),
    }, ensure_ascii=False))
    sys.exit(1)
